landing.heroTitle: The sales CRM your team will actually keep up to date
landing.heroBody: Nexora turns leads, accounts and deals into one calm workspace. Drag a deal, log a call, see the forecast move — in English or Arabic.
landing.heroNote: No sign-up · Sample data · Three roles to explore
landing.trusted: Built for sales teams across the Gulf, Egypt, Europe and North America
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a sales team touches, in one place
landing.featuresBody: No plugins to stitch together. Nexora ships with the workflow most teams build by hand.

pipeline.title: Pipeline you can feel
pipeline.body: Drag deals between stages with the mouse or keyboard. Values, probabilities and forecasts update instantly.

leads.title: Lead scoring & conversion
leads.body: Score inbound leads, bulk-assign them, and convert to contact, company and deal in one step.

activities.title: Follow-ups that don't slip
activities.body: Calls, meetings, emails and tasks with an overdue view, so no deal goes quiet.

reports.title: Reports leaders trust
reports.body: Revenue by rep, win/loss reasons, funnel by source and a probability-weighted forecast.

roles.title: Roles & audit trail
roles.body: Admins, managers and reps each see what they should. Every change is recorded.

bilingual.title: Arabic & English, properly
bilingual.body: Full right-to-left layout, localized numbers and dates, and a typeface designed for both scripts.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: Leads arrive from your site, ads, events and referrals — scored and routed to an owner.

qualify.title: Qualify
qualify.body: Reps log calls and notes. Qualified leads convert into a contact, company and deal.

close.title: Close
close.body: Deals move across the board. Won deals update the customer record and the forecast.

faq.a1: Nexora is a portfolio project by Mohamed Mohsen. The CRM is fully functional, but all companies, people and figures in the demo are fictional.
faq.q2: Can I try it without signing up?
faq.a2: Yes. Open the demo and pick a role — admin, manager or sales rep. Each sees the app with different permissions.
faq.a3: Yes. Switch the language at any time; the whole interface mirrors to right-to-left, with localized numbers and dates.
faq.a4: Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, Tailwind CSS and Motion — with tests and CI on GitHub Actions.

landing.ctaTitle: See your pipeline the way your team should
landing.ctaBody: Jump into a workspace full of realistic sample data. It takes one click.
landing.footer: A portfolio project by Mohamed Mohsen. All demo data is fictional.
